khata_values.name: khata_values
khata_values.value: "khata_entries"."amount_paise" BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991 AND (("khata_entries"."kind" = 'sale_debit' AND "khata_entries"."sale_id" IS NOT NULL AND "khata_entries"."method" IS NULL) OR ("khata_entries"."kind" = 'payment' AND "khata_entries"."sale_id" IS NULL AND "khata_entries"."method" IN ('cash','upi')))

product_values.name: product_values
product_values.value: "products"."base_unit" IN ('gram','each') AND "products"."price_quantity" > 0 AND "products"."price_paise" BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991 AND "products"."safety_stock" >= 0

sale_item_values.name: sale_item_values
sale_item_values.value: "sale_items"."quantity" > 0 AND "sale_items"."price_quantity" > 0 AND "sale_items"."base_unit" IN ('gram','each') AND "sale_items"."price_paise" BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991 AND "sale_items"."line_total_paise" BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991

sale_values.name: sale_values
sale_values.value: "sales"."total_paise" BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991 AND "sales"."payment_method" IN ('cash','upi','credit') AND ("sales"."payment_method" <> 'credit' OR "sales"."customer_id" IS NOT NULL)
